note: Proposed by R-019 (stream D) for the maintainer. Not a protected file: evidence/protected/ is maintainer-only and nothing here edits it. The suite reads this file by default and reads a protected file instead when one is passed with --tolerances. An element passes when |got - ref| <= atol_rel * scale + rtol * |ref|, with ref from CpuOps (double, rounded once to the element type), or from an upstream golden, and scale the RMS of ref (or the largest |V| of the pool for attention). Exact classes compare bytes. The values are the ones R-017 proposed (kernels/README.md) and measured against SM 86; the largest utilisation each class reached in R-019's own runs is in the results files, not here. The classes hybrid-f32 and gdn-* are new (R-019, for the R-034 hybrid ops): they were sized from one preliminary SM 86 and SM 89 run of the hybrid cases (identical maxima on both), as powers of two with the worst element at or below half the limit, before the committed runs. gdn-chunk-* are loose because FLA's chunk path rounds its intermediates to bf16. A case may name a class per output (state outputs, f32 outputs beside bf16 activations, the chunked GatedDeltaRule).
